scope: Ordinary clan recruitment, manual/automatic admission, cancellation, approval/rejection, leave/kick, deputy changes and native notifications; master-transfer consent/training clan remain separate.
trusted_source: Actor account/character and target identity/name/old role reloaded under sorted character locks; per-clan row serializes membership counts and recruitment.
disbanded: No admission, promotion or recruitment changes; reject/cancel/leave cleanup allowed.
manual_admission: C1032 only mode 1; persist pending; S1034 result1/current role1; S1035 to officers. Existing membership fails with trusted current status.
auto_admission: C1033 mode2 plus exact trusted character name; persist role100 in one transaction; S1034 result1/current role100 then S1016 authoritative profile. Do not use result2: native text and side effects are training-specific. Existing accepted peers get fresh S1018/S1012, no invented old role.
capacity: Only accepted 100/101/102 count; enforce under clan lock before approve/auto join.

member_changes.101 changes: Refuse; never bypass native transfer consent

self_member_changes: Refuse; use C1036 for ordinary leave. Master cannot leave through this request.
cancel: C1063 matching own pending clan only; S1064 result1 and S1016 absent; S1065 to officers.
leave: C1036 role100/102 only; S1037 old->negative20 then absent profile; same notification to other accepted members. Refused leave resynchronizes S1016.
change_reply: S1040 result1 for committed change, 2 only capacity failure, negative102 deputy conflict; other failures result0. Target gets S1041 and current profile, approval first seeds the trusted previous pending profile for native cached pending-id use.
recruitment_reply: S1103 result1/current mode on commit, result0 for refusal; others receive fresh S1018, officers get S1035 when stopped with pending applicants. Stop does not silently erase pending rows.
revocation: Authority checked before transaction and at commit decision; rollback before commit, no events on failure.
notifications: Serialize clan session operations and publish committed events in order to current connection generations; bounded inbox overflow closes that generation and reconnect reloads authoritative profile. Offline clients recover via profile, no durable history promised.
main_2025: Strictly decode authenticated native state report; never adopt reported clan/role as authority and do not invent an acknowledgement.
schema: New migration13 expands 0/1 recruitment to 0/1/2 while preserving old scripts and data.
